Deadly earthquakes strike Indonesia and Colombia, rescue efforts underway

A 7.7-magnitude earthquake struck Indonesia, killing at least 53 people and forcing 5,000 to evacuate, with landslides and aftershocks hindering rescue operations. In Colombia, a powerful earthquake has killed at least 285 people, injured 4,000, and left hundreds missing, with rescue efforts entering a final phase. Tens of thousands of homes were damaged in Colombia, leaving many displaced.
